load_generator_for_inference: load a BigGAN or StyleGAN2 generator network from checkpoint weights for inference
sample_generated_images: sample generated images from a BigGAN or StyleGAN2 generator given noise and conditioning
prepare_sampling_function: prepare a sampling function and inception moments filename for FID metric computation
add_backbone_cli_argument: add a --model_backbone CLI argument to an argparse parser with biggan or stylegan2 choices
configure_longtail_sampling: configure class label sampling with long-tail distribution weights for generator inference
